external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Portumna Community School’s Senior Camogie team are playing in the ALL-Ireland Colleges Senior C Camogie Semi Final this Saturday, February 1st v’s St Patricks High School, Keady.

A huge congratulations to our Portumna Community School Junior Cup rugby team, who secured a fantastic 28-14 victory over a gallant St. Raphael’s in their semi-final clash. This hard-fought win sees them progress to the final, where they will take on Calasanctius Oranmore.

Oversees teaching and learning, curriculum development, and academic standards. Promotes the use of the Athena tracker/mentoring sessions/assemblies and reporting to parents/teachers. Staff/student/parent training in this area. Linking directly with Athena and Year Head team (working with the SLT-P and DP). Student Services Supervised Study Book Scheme. |

Students from Portumna Community School, along with their teacher Ms. Hough, showed wonderful generosity by donating to the Team Hope Christmas Shoebox Appeal, which brings gifts to children in need worldwide. In the photo, from left to right, Liam Lawless, Joshua Broderick, Ms. Hough, Jane O’Rourke, Rhona Kelly, and Lucy Mahony proudly display the students gifts. Well done to all involved for making a difference!
